_doc: DISTRIBUTION ENVELOPE MANIFEST (epistemic prevention, wave EP-1).
One canonical home for every derived rate/count bound in the estate. A test reads
instead of hardcoding an integer, so a bound and its provenance can never drift
apart. tests/lint/distributionEnvelopePower.test.js re-derives every entry from its
measured base rate and reds if the registered bound, the margin, or the provenance
Entry schema: id, file, n, baseRate, baseMeasuredAt, baseMeasurementN (>= 400),
loosenPending=true means the DERIVED bound is looser than the live one. The live
(tighter) bound stays in force and the derivation goes to the owner queue — program
law: never loosen a bound silently.
The TOTALITY ROSTER — which distribution-shaped test files owe an entry here — lives
in tests/lint/distributionEnvelopePower.test.js as a frozen, shrink-only literal, not
in this file. Rows there start pendingMigration and retire as wave EP-2D measures each
base rate and registers the derivation below. This file started empty by design;
it fills only through that gate, one derived entry at a time.

entries.measurementContext: minifold claude/composite-r4 d0fdcf7c, live tree carrying unrelated foreign dirt (none in this instrument's path)
entries.notes: 9/400 ordinary towns read corrupted at birth. The old ceiling of 10 sat only 0.34 sigma above that measured base and could red on a single additional town; it was not a useful drift detector. Owner delegation on 2026-07-28 ratified the alpha-1e-3 derived ceiling of 20 (5.0% of the corpus), which carries 3.709 sigma of power.

entries.measurementContext: minifold claude/composite-r4 d0fdcf7c, live tree carrying unrelated foreign dirt (none in this instrument's path)
entries.notes: 1/400 ordinary cities read corrupted at birth. THIN BASE: a single observed event, so alpha is set to 1e-4 rather than the program default 1e-3 — the extra decade of budget is a hedge on the base rate itself, not on the corpus (which is seeded and fixed). At 1e-3 the derivation is 6. The authored ceiling was Math.round(400*0.025)=10, shared with the town and village sweeps; adopting 7 tightens it.

entries.notes: THE TRIGGER INSTRUMENT of the epistemic-prevention program. 27/400 = 6.75% of 90-criminal-priority towns reach full capture. The live ceiling 40 (Math.round(400*0.1)) is RATIFIED: the alpha-1e-3 envelope derives 45, which is LOOSER, and program law forbids silently weakening a live bound. Not a defect — 40 carries 2.59 sigma and is EXACTLY the alpha-1e-2 derivation. Owner delegation ratified the stricter 40 ceiling on 2026-07-28.

entries.measurementContext: minifold claude/composite-r4 3aa08f1d, live tree carrying unrelated foreign dirt (none in this instrument's path)
entries.notes: The unwalled baseline arm of the walls-suppress-sieges paired comparison: siege-family stress types summed over 120 unwalled `siege-${i}` runs. Measured 62/400 on the extended family (15.5%) against 21/120 on the test's OWN corpus (17.5%) — 0.61 sigma apart, so no corpus/family divergence here (contrast the `envelope-${i}` corner, 4/50 vs 89/400). The live floor 10 is RATIFIED: the alpha-1e-3 envelope derives 6, which is LOOSER, and program law forbids silently weakening a live bound. The stricter 10 still carries 2.17 sigma. Owner delegation ratified it on 2026-07-28. Two side notes. (1) The file header's comment claimed 'empirically 18' unwalled sieges; the current measurement is 21, a stale comment rather than a bound failure, refreshed at the assertion. (2) This arm is mildly OVERDISPERSED relative to a Bernoulli — two of 400 seeds carry two siege types (distribution 0:340 1:58 2:2) — so a derived bound would be optimistically tight. Harmless here precisely because the derivation is the looser side and is not adopted.

entries.measurementContext: minifold claude/composite-r4 3aa08f1d, live tree carrying unrelated foreign dirt (none in this instrument's path)
entries.notes: The walled arm of the same paired comparison: 23/400 (5.75%) on the extended family, 6/120 (5.00%) on the test's own corpus — no divergence. This is a NEW ABSOLUTE ceiling, added ALONGSIDE the pre-existing RELATIVE assertion (walledSieges <= floor(unwalledSieges * 0.7)), which is kept rather than replaced: the ratio is blind to both arms inflating together, and this envelope is blind to a suppression collapse that scales both, so they red on different worlds. Assertion count goes up, never down. The walled arm is exactly Bernoulli per seed (0:377 1:23 at N=400), so the binomial model is exact on this entry.

entries.measurementContext: minifold claude/composite-r4 3aa08f1d, live tree carrying unrelated foreign dirt (none in this instrument's path)
entries.notes: Anti-vacuity floor on the opt-in ancient-ruin mint rate: at least one seed of the sweep must mint, or the whole body of per-mint assertions above it is vacuous. Measured 43/400 on the `anc-${i}` family (10.75%); per-block-of-40 counts are 5,6,4,1,4,4,3,6,3,7, and the test's own first-80 block measures 11 (13.75%, 0.87 sigma high) — no divergence. THE CORPUS WAS DOUBLED 40 -> 80 TO BUY THIS ENTRY ITS POWER: at the authored N=40 the floor of 1 sits 1.685 sigma from the mean and FAILS the program's 2-sigma gate, and no bound above the vacuous 0 can reach 2 sigma at that N (the ceiling of the achievable margin there is 2.195, at bound 0). At N=80 the same floor carries 2.743. The alpha-1e-3 derivation is 0, which is vacuous — a count cannot be negative — and looser, so the live floor of 1 stays in force and the derivation is filed rather than adopted. Runtime cost of the doubling: ~135 ms.

entries.measurementContext: minifold claude/composite-r4 3aa08f1d, live tree carrying unrelated foreign dirt (none in this instrument's path)
entries.notes: The 'nowhere near universal' ceiling on the same mint rate — the small-generation-time-chance posture. The authored bound was `minted < 20` over 40 seeds: a rate ceiling of 47.5% against a 10.75% base, 7.5 sigma out. Re-derived on the doubled 80-seed corpus the ceiling is 19 again in COUNT terms, which is a 2x TIGHTENING in RATE terms (23.75% vs 47.5%) and carries 3.754 sigma. The doubling is what makes both sides of this two-sided instrument powered at once; see the floor entry for why N had to move.

entries.measurementContext: minifold claude/composite-r4 f9560c57, live tree carrying unrelated foreign dirt from concurrent sessions (including pulse-chain files); at that PRE-self-capture-fix tree the 16-run corpus re-measured to exactly the 2026-07-27 reading of 207 mission ids, proving the dirt behaviour-neutral for this instrument. The 207 is pre-fix provenance: the self-capture fix that shipped with this entry (11c295c1) removes 3 of the 6 release legs, so the same corpus reads 204 ids at HEAD — the genesis numerator 201, and this baseRate, are unchanged
entries.notes: The 3-year lit soak's journey cadence, expressed as a COUNT of GENESIS departures over the fixture's 12 NPCs x 3 years = 36 NPC-year trials. The trial unit is exact by the same test's cadence assertion (at most one genesis departure per NPC-year), and the denominator is fixed by the fixture rather than by an outcome, so this needs no fixed-n workaround. RE-DERIVED 2026-07-28 from the ratified GENESIS base rate 201/576 = 34.8958% (was 207/576 = 35.9375%): the earlier measurement counted every mission id, and a release-return leg (releasedFromRansom) is the RESOLUTION of a captivity, not a fresh dispatch — 6 of those 207 ids were release legs. The 16-run corpus is unchanged (the test's literal seed 'roads-3y' plus `roads-3y-0`..`roads-3y-14`), and the test's own seed mints no release leg, so it still yields 16/36 (44.4%), 1.20 sigma high — no divergence. The authored floor was perNpcYear > 0.05, i.e. >= 2 departures; the live floor of 4 remains RATIFIED even though the alpha-1e-3 derivation is the looser 3 (3.344 sigma; the live 4 carries 2.994, still over the program's 2-sigma bar). Owner delegation ratified the stricter 4 floor on 2026-07-28. A denominator guard in the test pins 36, so a change to the fixture's NPC roster reds instead of silently re-scaling what this bound means.

entries.measurementContext: minifold claude/composite-r4 f9560c57, live tree carrying unrelated foreign dirt from concurrent sessions (including pulse-chain files); at that PRE-self-capture-fix tree the 16-run corpus re-measured to exactly the 2026-07-27 reading of 207 mission ids, proving the dirt behaviour-neutral for this instrument. The 207 is pre-fix provenance: the self-capture fix that shipped with this entry (11c295c1) removes 3 of the 6 release legs, so the same corpus reads 204 ids at HEAD — the genesis numerator 201, and this baseRate, are unchanged
entries.notes: Ceiling arm of the same cadence band, re-derived 2026-07-28 from the ratified GENESIS base rate 201/576 = 34.8958% (see the floor entry for why 6 release-return legs left the numerator). The authored bound was perNpcYear < 0.9, i.e. <= 32 departures of a possible 36 — 6.797 sigma out, reachable only if nearly every NPC travelled every year. The derivation returns 23 (63.9% per NPC-year) UNCHANGED at the new base rate, and its power rises from 3.495 to 3.650 sigma. THE 2026-07-27 FINDING IS WITHDRAWN, and this is the record of why: the '5 cadence-law violations across 16 seeds' (roads-3y-7, roads-3y-9, roads-3y-12 twice, roads-3y-13) were an ARTEFACT OF THIS INSTRUMENT, not a producer defect. Every one of the five was a single interrupted journey counted twice — the release path mints a NEW mission id with startedYear = the RELEASE year (roadsKernel.js PASS 4), and the old counting summed every mission id per npcKey|startedYear. Each of the five keys holds exactly one releasedFromRansom leg. Re-measured after the counting was realigned with the charter (2026-07-28): GENESIS violations are 0 across all 17 seeds (the 16-run corpus plus `roads-3y-15`). The cadence law is real and correctly enforced at the genesis stamps in roadsKernel.js PASS 5. A DIFFERENT, REAL producer defect surfaced from the same investigation and was fixed under EP-6 (finding EP-l): SELF-CAPTURE (a court taking its own envoy hostage), which accounted for 4 of the 7 ransoms in this corpus.

entries.notes: The 40-seed test corpus supplies exactly 15,053 eligible settlement-year rolls after cooldown and records 147 strikes. The measured 400-seed extension records 1,317 strikes over 151,372 eligible rolls (0.87%). The alpha-1e-3 derivation would loosen the floor to 96; owner delegation ratified the stricter live 100-count floor on 2026-07-28. It remains in force and carries 2.717 sigma.

entries.measurementContext: minifold claude/composite-r4 a3922f2a, live tree carrying unrelated foreign dirt from a concurrent realm-directive wave (neutral-connected default + full auto-resolve). That work is DARK behind the virtual neutralNeighborsEnabled flag, which is ABSENT from this instrument's simulationRules, so buildWorldSnapshot returns the same graph object it returned pre-wire; the instrument's realm is single-settlement in any case, so a neighbour-edge default has nothing to connect. Proven behaviour-neutral by re-measurement at the dirty tree: all nine corpus counts are unchanged.
entries.notes: THE ANTI-VACUITY ANCHOR for the matched-pressure ceilings. 42/400 village settlements drift within 8 pulse advances with NO stressors attached (10.5%), and every one of those events is a PROMOTION. Without a floor here, a corpus that had simply stopped drifting at all would satisfy every matched-pressure ceiling in this family while measuring nothing. The test's own first-120 corpus measures 16 (13.33%), 1.01 sigma high, so there is no corpus/family divergence.

entries.measurementContext: minifold claude/composite-r4 a3922f2a, live tree carrying unrelated foreign dirt from a concurrent realm-directive wave (neutral-connected default + full auto-resolve), proven behaviour-neutral for this instrument by re-measurement at the dirty tree
entries.notes: Middle rung of the calm control arm: 44/400 (11.0%). The three calm rates (10.5 / 11.0 / 10.75 percent) are statistically indistinguishable, and that TIER-FLATNESS is the load-bearing control — it is what licenses reading the matched-pressure spread as a stressor effect rather than a pre-existing tier gradient. The flatness itself is asserted as a spread bound, never as an ordering: a strict inequality between three equal rates would be over-fitting one corpus. Test's own corpus 15/120 (12.5%), 0.53 sigma high.

entries.measurementContext: minifold claude/composite-r4 a3922f2a, live tree carrying unrelated foreign dirt from a concurrent realm-directive wave (neutral-connected default + full auto-resolve), proven behaviour-neutral for this instrument by re-measurement at the dirty tree
entries.notes: The control that gives the directive-6 bound its meaning: 43/400 (10.75%) of the SAME city corpus drifts within 8 advances with no stressors. The matched-pressure city rate is 40/400 (10.0%) — indistinguishable from this unstressed baseline, which is the sharpest statement of the inertia: the five-archetype matched load moves the city arm essentially not at all, while it moves the village arm from 10.5% to 84.25%. Test's own corpus 12/120 (10.0%), 0.27 sigma low.

entries.measurementContext: minifold claude/composite-r4 a3922f2a, live tree carrying unrelated foreign dirt from a concurrent realm-directive wave (neutral-connected default + full auto-resolve), proven behaviour-neutral for this instrument by re-measurement at the dirty tree
entries.notes: THE LOW-TIER ARM of the tier-inertia paired comparison (realm directive 6 / J-D6). 337/400 generated villages (84.25%) demote within 8 pulse advances under a held five-archetype stressor load at severity 0.7. This floor is what keeps the two ceilings in this family honest: a corpus that stopped responding to stressors would satisfy them vacuously. Separated STRUCTURALLY from the town ceiling (42) and the city ceiling (24), so the ordering village > town > city survives a corpus re-draw rather than resting on one. Test's own corpus 96/120 (80.0%), 1.28 sigma low.

entries.measurementContext: minifold claude/composite-r4 a3922f2a, live tree carrying unrelated foreign dirt from a concurrent realm-directive wave (neutral-connected default + full auto-resolve), proven behaviour-neutral for this instrument by re-measurement at the dirty tree
entries.notes: The middle rung under matched stressors: 89/400 (22.25%), between the village 84.25% and the city 10.0%. DELIBERATELY NOT PAIRED with a strict town > city corpus assertion: the town/city difference is 14.7 counts against a 5.6-count paired standard error (2.6 sigma), so a corpus re-draw could flip the two, and the severity sweep already shows one reversal (at severity 0.5 the town arm measured 0/40 against the city arm's 1/40). Only village > town and village > city are claimed. Test's own corpus 21/120 (17.5%), 1.25 sigma low.

entries.measurementContext: minifold claude/composite-r4 a3922f2a, live tree carrying unrelated foreign dirt from a concurrent realm-directive wave (neutral-connected default + full auto-resolve), proven behaviour-neutral for this instrument by re-measurement at the dirty tree
entries.notes: THE DIRECTIVE-6 BOUND. 40/400 generated cities (10.0%) demote within 8 pulse advances under the SAME held stressor load that demotes 84.25% of villages — and 10.0% is the city corpus's own unstressed baseline (10.75%), so the matched load moves the high rung essentially not at all. A red here means high-tier inertia eroded. The inertia is EMERGENT, not structural: every demotion in this corpus fires the population-independent structural-failure branch (support <= 0.25), and that branch is scale-free — matched support plus matched relative headroom yields an identical verdict at village, town, and city (severity 0.48, minimum streak 2, probability 0.9452, pinned in the test). The gradient comes entirely from the causal derivation absorbing the identical shock differently by tier, which is exactly what this envelope is positioned to catch if a tuning pass moves it. Test's own corpus 14/120 (11.67%), 0.61 sigma high.

entries.measurementContext: minifold claude/composite-r4 a3922f2a, live tree carrying unrelated foreign dirt from a concurrent realm-directive wave (neutral-connected default + full auto-resolve), proven behaviour-neutral for this instrument by re-measurement at the dirty tree
entries.notes: The acute arm, low rung: 398/400 (99.5%) at severity 1.0 on the same five archetypes. NOT degenerate — 2 of 400 villages still ride out a full-severity load, so a binomial envelope is licensed here where a 400/400 reading would have forced a totality invariant instead (the distribution.test.js precedent). Test's own corpus 118/120 (98.33%), 1.81 sigma low, the widest divergence in this family and still inside the band.

entries.notes: The acute arm, middle rung: 390/400 (97.5%). Test's own corpus 117/120 (97.5%), 0.00 sigma — the family and the corpus agree exactly here.

entries.measurementContext: minifold claude/composite-r4 a3922f2a, live tree carrying unrelated foreign dirt from a concurrent realm-directive wave (neutral-connected default + full auto-resolve), proven behaviour-neutral for this instrument by re-measurement at the dirty tree
entries.notes: THE GAP-CLOSING BOUND — the 'unless matched by acute pressure' half of realm directive 6. The SAME 400 city seeds that demote at 10.0% under the matched load demote at 95.5% (382/400) when the identical five archetypes are raised to full severity. The closure is proven STRUCTURALLY, not by corpus luck: this floor (105) sits far above the matched-pressure city ceiling (24), so any corpus satisfying both has recorded the lift. A red means acute pressure no longer overwhelms high-tier inertia, which would make the inertia an immunity rather than a resistance. Test's own corpus 117/120 (97.5%), 1.06 sigma high.
